title: Classify V21 global-library product/support prerequisites without publishing Siemens text
goal: After the prerequisite-tag harness is merged and green, extend the worker's privacy-safe EngineeringException classification so official support-package/software-product/unsupported-library-element prerequisite wording can map to fixed bounded tags while raw MessageData/DetailMessageData text remains runner-local and migration semantics remain unchanged.

prerequisite.rule: Do not dispatch until the harness task implementation is independently approved, merged to trusted main and post-merge CI is green.

baselineEvidence.officialResearch: Issue #61 comment 5752402710: V19->V21 direct global-library upgrade is supported; RetrieveWithUpgrade is the correct API; EngineeringTargetInvocationException exposes reason/detail surfaces; usable library elements can require installed TIA software products, licenses and support packages. Missing prerequisite is evidence-backed but not yet proven.

scope: Preserve exactly RetrieveWithUpgrade -> Save -> Archive -> close -> current-version Retrieve. Do not add retries, alternate migration APIs, OpenMode changes, headless/UI changes, exception swallowing or product-specific workarounds.

Add one small Siemens-independent classifier helper and focused tests. Program.cs may only adapt EngineeringException MessageData.Text/DetailMessageData.Text into that helper and append its returned fixed tags/fingerprints to the existing public failure token.
Classifier output may only use the existing tags plus support-package-missing, software-product-missing and unsupported-library-element. It must never return arbitrary words from Siemens text.

Use conservative case-insensitive phrase-family matching that requires both a supported prerequisite noun/context and explicit absence/unavailable/unsupported semantics. Generic mentions of a support package/product/library element without a missing/unavailable/unsupported indication must not classify as a missing prerequisite.
Keep license-missing behavior and all existing tag/fingerprint semantics. If no supported category matches, emit unknown. Multiple safe tags are sorted/deduplicated deterministically.

MessageData.Text and DetailMessageData.Text are used only in memory for classification/fingerprinting; raw text, product names, library object names, absolute paths, usernames and vendor payload must never enter public Failure/stdout/artifact/issue evidence.
The helper must be BCL/net48-compatible and linkable into SiemensBackend.Tests for Linux net10 execution plus net48 compile evidence without compiling full TiaV21Worker on Linux.

Focused tests use synthetic safe phrases and sentinel private path/user/vendor text. They must prove supported phrase families map only to fixed tags, ambiguous/generic text stays unknown, output ordering is deterministic, and sentinels are absent.
No Valve contract discovery/reference compile is authorized by this diagnostic task. If the next trusted run remains tags:unknown, stop and retain BLOCKED diagnosis rather than speculating.

requirements: Candidate changes are limited exactly to candidatePolicy.allowedPaths.
Migration/qualification control flow and all fresh/reuse/provenance/archive transaction semantics are unchanged.
Classifier is Siemens-independent, net48-compatible and directly tested on Linux.
support-package-missing requires support-package context plus explicit missing/not-installed/not-available/required-but-unavailable semantics; plain mention alone does not match.
software-product-missing requires software-product/product context plus explicit missing/not-installed/not-available/required-but-unavailable semantics; plain mention alone does not match.
unsupported-library-element requires library element/type/object context plus explicit unsupported/cannot-be-used semantics; generic library text alone does not match.
No arbitrary raw diagnostic text or identifiers are emitted; public output remains fixed tags + bounded counts/fingerprints.
Existing diagnostic tags, unknown fallback and deterministic fingerprint construction remain intact.
Exact-SHA Linux CI is green and no candidate Windows/TIA execution occurs.
Coding-agent authored candidate requires independent primary chatgpt review; if primary materially authors candidate code, reviewer switches to fresh chatgpt-secondary.
tia: After independent approval and trusted merge, run exactly one /run-olq-001 on trusted main.
If RetrieveWithUpgrade still fails, sanitized evidence either resolves to one or more supported prerequisite tags or remains unknown; raw Siemens text is never published.
Do not change migration APIs or claim a qualified Valve profile unless the unchanged OLQ success gates actually pass.
